verdict.rationale: Column's docs state that the API is defined by an OpenAPI spec, also available as JSON, which can be used to generate type-safe client SDKs. A probe confirmed that https://docs.column.com/openapi.json returns HTTP 200 with an "openapi" key, so the spec is downloadable and machine-readable. Missing for 10: independent community or hands-on corroboration of the spec's completeness or accuracy.
